passages.question: What is the 2026 threshold for Form 1099-NEC, and did it change?
passages.excerpt: For tax years beginning after 2025, the minimum threshold amount for reporting certain payments required to be reported on certain information returns and/or perform backup withholding on those payments increased to $2,000 and may be adjusted for inflation beginning in calendar year 2027. ... Enter nonemployee compensation (NEC) of $2,000 or more.

passages.question: When are the 2026 Forms 1099-NEC due, and must they be e-filed?
passages.excerpt: Section 6071(c) requires you to file Form 1099-NEC on or before January 31, using either paper or electronic filing procedures. ... If any date shown falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday ... the due date is the next business day. ... lowered the e-file threshold to 10 (calculated by aggregating all information returns)

passages.question: Which vendors are left out as corporations, merchandise or card payments?
passages.excerpt: Generally, payments to a corporation (including an LLC) that is treated as a C or S corporation). ... Payments for merchandise, telegrams, telephone, freight, storage, and similar items. ... Payments made with a credit card or payment card ... must be reported on Form 1099-K by the payment settlement entity under section 6050W and are not subject to reporting on Form 1099-MISC or Form 1099-NEC.
